description: A quantiser for unequal temperaments: it quantises a note CV to the 12-tone equal tempered chromatic scale and then detunes each of the twelve pitches by the amount you set.

params.text: Shifts every note quantised to C away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to C sharp away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to D away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to D sharp away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to E away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to F away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to F sharp away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to G away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to G sharp away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to A away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to A sharp away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.
Shifts every note quantised to B away from equal temperament, -50 to +50 cents, with the amount shown in cents.

inputs.text: The note CV quantised to the 12-tone equal tempered chromatic scale before the detuning is applied.
A port kept from an earlier version of the module; nothing is read from it or sent to it.

outputs.text: Carries the quantised note CV with the detuning for that pitch applied.
A port kept from an earlier version of the module; nothing is read from it or sent to it.

notes: the index light in the knob for the pitch currently recognised turns red.
tunings are read when Rack starts, from the Scala .scl files in the plugin's Scala folder and from a WK_Custom.tunings file beside that folder.
no WK_Custom.tunings file is installed; the plugin ships WK_Custom.tunings.template in the same folder, to copy under the shorter name and fill in with your own offsets in cents.
a Scala file is rejected if any of its ratios is more than 50 cents from equal temperament, and only the first twelve ratios in a file are read.
menu: Equal Temperament 12-ET, Andreas Werckmeister's temperament III and the other tuning names — the menu ends with one item per loaded tuning, and choosing one sets all twelve detunings at once.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · stepped · one channel only
